scripts.title: script spinning skybox
scripts.script:
local sky = game.Lighting.Sky
local rotationSpeedX = 50 -- Speed for X axis
local rotationSpeedZ = 50 -- Speed for Z axis
local rotationSpeedY = 50 -- Speed for Y axis

game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
local newX = (sky.SkyboxOrientation.X + rotationSpeedX * deltaTime) % 360
local newZ = (sky.SkyboxOrientation.Z + rotationSpeedZ * deltaTime) % 360
local newY = (sky.SkyboxOrientation.Y + rotationSpeedY * deltaTime) % 360
sky.SkyboxOrientation = Vector3.new(newX, newY, newZ)
end)

-- This will spin the skybox around all three axes.
